newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's household savings rise slows down in May.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's household savings rise slows down in May.

text.p: Hungary's net household savings rose 23.3 billion forints in May and 208.5 billion in the first five months of the year, down from 53 billion forints in May 1996 and 224.7 billion in January-May 1996, the National Bank of Hungary said on Thursday.
NOTE - May 1997 figures are preliminary. The figures are not inflation- adjusted.
The NBH said that the rise of net household savings slowed in May as many company paid wages due between May 1 and 4 already in April.
It is also remarkable, that after two years of fall the loans held by households rose in both April and May, although only slightly, the NBH added.

Consumer price inflation was 17.7 percent year-on-year in May. Monthly average real wages rose 7.2 percent in the first four months of the year from the same period of 1996, accordingh to the statistical office KSH's latest figures.
